  "summary": "This handwritten English aerogram, dated 22 August 1964 and sent from the Inter-Parliamentary Union Conference in Copenhagen, is addressed to Minoo Masani, General Secretary of the Swatantra Party. The sender, signing only as “Ranga,” reports on the conference, including a Pakistani delegate’s accusation against India and the sender’s effort to keep discussion open and oriented toward understanding, compromise, and settlement. The letter also mentions a planned international delegation and the cost-related abandonment of travel from London to Washington, with a possible return to Delhi by 6 September.\n\nThe latter part of the letter turns to internal Swatantra Party concerns. South Indian party colleagues have asked about the “Bihar debacle,” while Rampathi and “Settla” are said to complain that they were condemned without being heard. The sender reports that P. K. Ghosh appears to have aligned with them and notes B. R. Reddi’s suggestion that the Central Organisation be convened. The document is a brief piece of political correspondence rather than a developed policy argument; its significance lies in its contemporaneous account of international party activity, travel arrangements, and tensions within the Swatantra Party.",
